coaching.title: Today's Run
coaching.message: Easy 6–7 miles, Z2 (140–150 bpm ceiling), rolling terrain. You're 44 days out and in taper—volume is dropping but you need to hold neural sharpness and keep the engine primed. Your resting HR is 61 (down from 65 avg), which tells me you're recovering well. Wednesday's vert work in Build/Peak phases shifts to *easy* vert in Taper. Aim for 400–600 ft of gain, nothing steep or threshold. Keep it smooth; this is about maintaining aerobic efficiency and leg stiffness without the fatigue tax.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You're logging only 5.2 miles so far this week—your usual weekly volume is ~32 miles. Taper hunger is real and deceptive. Don't under-fuel because volume is lower; maintain your base caloric intake and prioritize carbs (aim for 6–8g/kg body weight daily if you're typical for your profile). Post-run today, hit 1.2g carb per kg within 30 min, paired with 20–30g protein. Your 6.58h sleep is 90 min short of your 30-day average—fuel strategically to support sleep depth tonight.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Recovery score is 74/100 (green zone), but sleep last night was suboptimal at 6.58h. Taper paradoxically stresses nervous system because reduced training volume can trigger cortisol dysregulation if sleep suffers. Tonight: no screens after 21:30, dark room, cool (64–67°F if possible), and consider magnesium glycinate 2–3h pre-bed. The short sleep + travel schedule is your limiting factor, not training load. Prioritize 8+ hours the next two nights to consolidate adaptation.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: You're in the hardest psychological phase: taper anxiety. Volume has dropped 84% week-over-week and you may feel undertrained—this is normal and false. At 44 days out, race-specific vert (2,500m across 50K) is now about movement quality and mountain-running neuromuscular patterns, not volume hammering. Use these easy runs to visualize the descent sections in Slovenia and ingrain efficient footwork on steeps. Trust the plan; you've logged the hard work. Today is about staying sharp and rested, not proving anything.
